leah: Alert from CI - Vault transit unwrap used KMS wrapper key during partner restore job. Suspect stale backups got rehydrated. Need quick containment.

omar: paste the log line and key id?

leah: `2025-11-03T14:05:02Z partner-restore INFO transit/unwrap ciphertext=Zk9... key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap principal=serviceAccount:partner-ci@partners.gserviceaccount.com`

mira: if that SA had direct decrypt rights we should revoke immediately and run a canary rewrap.

security-bot: queued actions: 1) dump KMS IAM for partner-wrap, 2) tail DATA_ACCESS logs for 48h, 3) create incident SEC-4901. Results in 2m.

omar: revoke plan: remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from partner-ci SA at key-level, set temporary org deny for decrypts, then rewrap Vault transit keys.

leah: started canary rewrap (dry-run) for transit/keys/partner in Vault at 1760001160. `vault write -field=ok transit/rewrap key=partner --dry-run=true`

mira: opening infra PR to replace broad KMS role with a conditional custom role limited to partner namespaces. Will include audit_configs change so DATA_ACCESS is always logged.

security-bot: iam dump shows partner-ci had decrypt role. Access log shows two decrypts in last 24h. Dump link: gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1760001111/kms-iam.txt

omar: revoke executed at 1760001180. Pause partner restore runners.

leah: dry-run rewrap found 6 ciphertexts. Proceeding to canary live rewrap now. `vault write transit/rewrap key=partner`

security-bot: canary rewrap complete: 6 rewrapped, 0 failures. logs: gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1760001111/rewrap.log

mira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4999 includes conditional role + terraform plan. Tagging infra for quick review.

omar: owners: rewrap=leah, IAM PR=mira, runners=omar, monitoring=omar. Follow-ups: rotate KMS key version, scan artifacts, add ephemeral restore tokens.

leah: moving to schedule full rewrap tonight during maintenance window. Will update SEC-4901 after completion. :lock:
